description: Supported-city catalog for the traveller onboarding city-picker. All 7 cities now have full POI-level seed data + a scripted disruption scenario (demo_ready: true). The judged on-stage demo should still walk ONE rehearsed city (Jaipur is the reference/most-tested), per the roadmap's Golden Rule — the others are real, working data, not just catalog filler, but pick one for the actual pitch run-through.

cities.name: Jaipur
cities.why: Heritage/desert circuit, deep POI data + the disruption scenario live here

cities.name: Goa
cities.why: Beach + nightlife category — shows category breadth beyond heritage

cities.name: Manali
cities.why: Mountain/adventure category, high disruption-relevance (weather/road closures are a real, common ripple trigger here)

cities.name: Munnar
cities.why: Backwaters/nature category, rounds out the domestic spread

cities.name: Bali
cities.why: Top outbound-from-India leisure destination — signals international scale to judges without an India-only ceiling

cities.name: Dubai
cities.why: Highest-volume outbound-from-India destination, visa-easy, strong operator/vendor-ecosystem story for the pilot pitch (roadmap Phase 6)

cities.name: Bangkok
cities.why: Budget-friendly, huge Indian tourist base — pairs well with the ₹3/itinerary unit-economics pitch line
